subject: Compliance readiness kickoff — SOC 2, IR timelines, and vendor Q next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@orthohealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Compliance readiness kickoff — SOC 2, IR timelines, and vendor Q next steps

Hi Jill — great demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the compliance items you asked about: 

Summary (from call)
- OrthoHealth wants assurance around SOC 2 status, data residency/GDPR controls for EU patients, and HIPAA coverage for PHI workflows.
- You asked for an IR / breach-notification timeline and BCP/DR evidence you can attach to your vendor onboarding packet.
- You indicated the security questionnaire (attached) is the gating item for procurement.

Next actions we propose
1) We attach a 1-page SOC 2 snapshot and the vendor security questionnaire template (our recommended starting answers). Please review and mark any questions you want us to expand on. (Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, vendor-security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx)
2) Rishi will provide a concise IR timeline doc with our notification SLA, escalation contacts, and post-incident evidence retention — target: by Tue EOD 24 Feb.
3) Monica will pull together BCP/DR evidence (DR runbook excerpt, backup verification logs) and a short narrative for your procurement team — target: Wed 25 Feb.
4) Laura (legal) to confirm DPA/BAA baseline and any contracting cadence you need.

Questions for you
- Do you need SOC 2 Type II report itself or is a SOC 2 snapshot and auditor contact sufficient at this stage?
- Any specific timeline constraints for the vendor questionnaire (procurement cutoff date)?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with Rishi and Monica and loop Laura once we have the questionnaire back from you.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (1p), vendor-security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx (workbook, 48 rows)
From: Jill Turner <jill.turner@orthohealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <mlee@orthohealth.com>, security@orthohealth.com
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance readiness kickoff — SOC 2, IR timelines, and vendor Q next steps

Ben — thanks for the clear summary. A few answers and one attachment from our side:

Quick answers
- Procurement needs the completed vendor questionnaire back by Fri 27 Feb to hit our vendor onboarding window.
- For SOC 2, we prefer the full SOC 2 Type II report where possible; if you can’t share it now, the snapshot + auditor contact is acceptable temporarily.
- HIPAA: we will only send PHI to vendors with an executed BAA. Please flag obvious BAA blockers early.

Attached: orthohealth-ir-timeline.xlsx — this is our preferred incident timeline template with mandatory fields that procurement asks for. Please map your timeline to these fields where you can. Also looping Marcus (security lead) to call out any technical clarifications.

I’ll review your questionnaire answers once you send them back.

Best,
Jill Turner
Head of Procurement, OrthoHealth Inc
jill.turner@orthohealth.com | +1 (617) 555-7922

Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 14:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance readiness kickoff — SOC 2, IR timelines, and vendor Q next steps

Hi Jill / Marcus — thanks for the template. I’ve mapped Redwood’s IR / breach-notification timeline to your required fields and attached a short spreadsheet (see: orthohealth-ir-timeline.xlsx in thread). Summary of key items for procurement/security review: 

Incident response & notification (high level)
- Detection to Triage: internal mean time to detect/acknowledge for high-severity incidents: 15–30 minutes.
- Containment: initial containment window: 1–4 hours for critical incidents depending on scope.
- Notification: internal stakeholders notified within 1 hour; external customers notified within 72 hours for incidents that meet our disclosure thresholds. We understand stricter SLAs may be required for PHI; please confirm if you require sub-72 hour notification for patient-impacting events.
- For GDPR/HIPAA overlap: we will assist with draft notification language and provide exported artifacts for your legal team within 7 calendar days post-incident for supported data types.

BCP/DR evidence being prepared
- Disaster recovery runbook excerpt (DR-runbook-excerpt.pdf) — will deliver with Monica’s packet.
- Last full restore test: Jan 2026 (logs and summary will be included).
- RTO/RPO for primary services: RTO 4 hours, RPO 1 hour in Dedicated topology; hosted API has different profiles which we’ll enumerate in the evidence pack.

Open questions for OrthoHealth security
1) Do you have a hard deadline for PHI notification SLA that differs from 72 hours?
2) Any specific packet formats procurement prefers for evidence (PDF bundle vs zip with CSV logs)?

Next step: Monica and I will assemble the evidence bundle and upload to a secure share by Wed 25 Feb EOD. Ben — can you confirm the external share method OrthoHealth prefers (SFTP, secure Drive link, or DocuSign-protected link)?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Compliance readiness kickoff — SOC 2, IR timelines, and vendor Q next steps

Rishi / team — appreciate the fast turnaround. A couple of clarifications from OrthoHealth security to make procurement comfortable: 

1) Notification SLA: for any incident involving ePHI we require notification to us within 24 hours.
2) Evidence format: PDF bundle is preferred for executive review; CSV logs ok as supplementary artifacts. Please include a one-page narrative describing the restore test methodology and who observed the test.
3) SOC 2: we will accept the snapshot + auditor contact for now but will need the Type II report before a BAA is executed.

Please upload the evidence bundle to our SFTP (details below) and send a secure download link. If you prefer DocuSign-protected share, that is also acceptable.

SFTP details: sftp.orthohealth.com:/inbound/vendor-evidence/ORT-8742 (user will be created after procurement okays the upload).

Laura — looping you for contract implications (BAA timing).

Regards,
Marcus Lee
Security Operations Manager
OrthoHealth Inc
mlee@orthohealth.com | +1 (617) 555-6310
